name: USD Pairs
description: Every pair quoted directly against the Dollar. Pure USD exposure, the most liquid pairs in the set.

name: CHF Pairs
description: All Swiss Franc exposure.

name: EUR Pairs
description: All Euro exposure.

name: GBP Pairs
description: All Pound Sterling exposure.

name: Reserve
description: USD, EUR, JPY, GBP. The world's top central-bank reserve currencies.

name: Risk
description: AUD and GBP are higher-beta, growth-sensitive. Rally hardest in risk-on markets.

name: North America
description: All built around the Canadian Dollar, the region's primary non-USD currency here.

name: Carry Trade
description: Higher-yield currencies (AUD, CAD, GBP) against the traditional low-yield funding currencies (JPY, CHF).

name: Transatlantic
description: Direct link between Europe (EUR, GBP) and North America (USD, CAD).

name: Major Pairs
description: The single highest-volume, most-traded pairs in the universe.

name: Minor Crosses
description: Lower-liquidity cross pairs, complementary to the Majors basket.

name: Non USD Pairs
description: Cross pairs with no USD leg. Moves independently of Dollar strength/weakness.

name: Diversification Mix
description: One pair per theme (major, carry, cross, haven, commodity). Built for minimal overlap.

name: Stable Pairs
description: Lower-volatility pairs with closely tied economies, tending toward mean-reverting and range-bound behavior.

name: Commodity Haven
description: Growth- and resource-sensitive currencies traded directly against traditional defensive safe havens.

name: AUD CAD Europe
description: Pairs linking resource-exporting commodity dollars (AUD, CAD) to major European economies.

name: Europe
description: Euro, Pound, and Swiss Franc. The three core European currencies.

name: Global
description: One pair touching each of the 7 currencies. Broadest possible spread across regions.

name: Commodity
description: AUD and CAD are resource-export economies. Both move with global growth and commodity prices.

name: Safe Haven
description: CHF, JPY, and USD are classic defensive currencies. Strengthen in risk-off conditions.

name: Asia Pacific
description: AUD and JPY both track the Pacific Rim growth/risk cycle closely.

name: CAD Pairs
description: All Canadian Dollar exposure.
